subject: Veteran Housing Incentive Program
overview: The committee discussed a pilot program providing rental rebates to landlords housing veterans and reviewed upcoming public engagement initiatives including the council newsletter and listening sessions.

items.title: Veteran housing incentives
items.summary: Referred a proposal to legal counsel and the full City Council that would establish a pilot program providing $750 annual rebates to owner-occupant landlords who rent to veterans. The program would be administered through the non-profit Housing Families using existing Veteran Services Office funds.

items.title: City Council newsletter
items.summary: Approved the draft newsletter contingent on incorporating the results of the evening's subsequent meetings and making minor clarifying edits to school department references.

items.title: City Council listening sessions update
items.summary: Finalized schedules for upcoming outreach sessions at the Senior Center, the Medford Public Library, and the West Medford Community Center. Members discussed strategies for reaching parents and lower-income residents who do not traditionally attend meetings in the council chambers.
